and if u want to see the textured outcome of this loopcut, it looks like you expect [Image #92] the faces that got hit by the loop cut all have them with a cut in the texture. its all coherent all the way through from uv to texture
resolution: Part 5.2 — selection-scoped UV panel + loop-cut UV coherence. Blockbench shows the SELECTED face's island: a full square on a base cube, and a HALF-square after a loop cut (the cut splits the UV island in half with the geometry — coherent UV->texture). Our cutMeshByPlane already interpolates per-corner UVs through a cut (so cutting a full-square face yields two half-square islands — the data was already correct, proven by the cut-lerp test), but the panel showed ALL faces overlapping so you couldn't see the selected half. Fixed: StudioViewport now publishes its face selection to the shared store (studioModel.selectedFaces, set by an effect on sel/selMode, only in face mode); UVPanel scopes to it — shows the selected face's island, or the whole atlas when nothing is selected. Added selectedFaces + setSelectedFaces to the store/StudioModel; passed onSelectFaces from StudioEditor to StudioViewport. editMesh 25/25, Studio.tsx + full sources.ts chain bundle clean. Hot-reload TSX, nothing committed. Remaining: 5c create-texture (box-net image + UV remap + paint), 5d image-to-image, per-face orientation parity.
